lines.xm_04_01: Good evening, senpai. There is something I would like to discuss today.
lines.xm_04_02: We are using more and more water and ingredients. I can hardly keep up with the orders.
lines.xm_04_03: If you have suitable supplies, could I buy from you regularly, from a list?
lines.xm_04_04: You could stock the drinks I make, too. Hehe, we would be proper business partners!
lines.xm_04_shop: I would like some drinking water today. I have {0} credits.
lines.xm_04_cocktail: I also brought two bottled juice drinks from the bar. Would you like a look?
lines.xm_04_accept: Thank you. Just what I needed.
lines.xm_04_bye: I should go. We can talk about supplies at my place tonight, if you like.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_01: Welcome, senpai. I made that list we discussed during the day.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_02: I would like to buy water and ingredients from you regularly. Once the drinks are made, we will split the batch as agreed: some for the bar, some for your shop.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_03: The quantities and prices are all written down. I want this to be a fair deal for you.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_yes: Wonderful! We will follow the list, then. Hehe, I feel a little closer to you now.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_later: Of course. No hurry. You have your own shop to look after.
lines.xm_w04_phone_01: Hello. Tenquin Asset Corporation, Merchant Development.
lines.xm_w04_phone_02: Pre-assessment applications are open for our alcohol and tobacco retailer support programme. A representative can visit your shop.
lines.xm_w04_phone_confirm: Your application is registered. We will send an assessor to your shop tomorrow to review your eligibility. You will be notified of the final result this Friday.
lines.xm_w04_phone_closed: We are sorry. Registration for this round has closed.
lines.xm_w04_audit_01: Hello. Tenquin Asset Corporation, Merchant Assessment. We arranged this visit yesterday.
lines.xm_w04_audit_02: I would like to see your alcohol and tobacco business. I can also buy suitable goods at normal prices.
lines.xm_w04_audit_shop: I am buying alcohol and tobacco products today. My budget is {0} credits.
lines.xm_w04_audit_accept: Thank you. This purchase will be included in our visit record.
lines.xm_w04_audit_no_trade: Understood. No purchase is necessary. The assessment will proceed as usual.
lines.xm_w04_audit_bye: Thank you for your cooperation. You will receive the result this Friday.
lines.xm_w04_wang_01: Hey. Heard you applied for that commercial street support scheme.
lines.xm_w04_wang_02: You are under my wing. I asked someone to stop that paperwork for you.
lines.xm_w04_wang_03: Do not feel bad about it. They call it support, but once you sign, it is a different story.
lines.xm_w04_wang_04: If it is such a good deal, why do they not run the business themselves?
lines.xm_w04_wang_bye: Anyway, look after your shop. Think things through next time.
lines.xm_04_03_existing: Senpai, I kept the supply list we agreed on. If you find something suitable, we can work through it at our own pace.
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_existing: The list is here, senpai. Are you delivering supplies today, or buying from me?
lines.xm_tavern_w04_supply_early: Welcome, senpai. I made a list of supplies for the bar. May I discuss it with you?
lines.xm_w04_audit_01_late: Hello. Tenquin Asset Corporation, Merchant Assessment. We arranged this visit earlier.

A.title: Dear shopkeeper,
A.body:
After mentioning supplies yesterday, I went back and made another list of what the bar needs.

I used to write down only what was missing that day. Now I am planning ingredients for the weeks ahead.

It is tiring, but I am happy.

There is still so much you can teach me about running a shop.

Please do not feel you have to agree right away. You have your own business. We can talk when it suits you.

Here is this week's tape. (´,,•ω•,,)♡

I have enclosed this week's supply categories. Come and see me if you are interested.

B.title: Dear shopkeeper,
B.body:
After closing last night, I wrote our two shops' supply arrangement into my ledger.

Now we are officially business partners.

There is still so much you can teach me about running a shop.

And if anything comes up at your shop, come to me too! I will help however I can.

Not long ago I only bought a little water from you and carried it home in one small bag.

If it turns into crates and crates one day, will your counter have room for them all...?

Before that, though, I need to work out the orders properly. We both have a good business to run.

Here is this week's tape. (´,,•ω•,,)♡
